## Results of the suite on a CPU build and a CUDA build (`-DCUDA`) {#sec-ch13-results}

### Summary

This section records what the whole suite gives at the code pin on two builds of the same source: one without CUDA
and one with CUDA. Each count comes with the command that produced it. Every failure and skip is explained by the
environment of the run, not by the code under test. A reader who runs the suite can use these numbers to tell an
environment problem from a real regression.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Measured pass, fail and skip counts of the suite at the pin.

**Data.** `ctest` and `pytest` summaries for a CPU build and a CUDA build.

**Placement.** After the build and install; see @sec-ch13-suite.

**Activation.** `cmake -B build -DCUDA=OFF` or `-DCUDA=ON`; the build itself is described in @sec-ch12.

**Guarantee / limits.** No failure comes from the code under test; one `ctest` entry fails for an environmental reason.

**Evidence.** See the Tests layer below.
:::

### Derivation

No derivation: this scheme records measurements.

### Numerical method

No numerical method. Both builds were Release builds of the pin, installed into a private directory with
`pip install . --no-build-isolation --no-deps --target <dir>`. Each was then tested in two ways:

1. a serial `ctest` run in `build/tests`, with the test inputs copied into that directory (@sec-ch13-suite, Limits);
2. one `pytest` run over the whole `tests/` directory from the source tree, against the installed build.

The CPU build was tested with no GPU visible, so its CUDA cases skip instead of failing on a build without CUDA
kernels.

### Tests

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| all 49 entries, CPU build | the suite passes | exact counts | the `ctest` summary |
| all 49 entries, CUDA build | the suite passes | exact counts | the `ctest` summary |

: Suite runs at the pin. {#tbl-ch13-results-tests}

On the CPU build, serial `ctest` passes 48 of 49 entries. `pytest` over `tests/` gives 412 passed, 174 skipped and
0 failed.[^ch13-results-cpu] Almost all of the 174 skips are CUDA cases with no GPU visible. The others are:

- 4 cases of `test_atm2d.py`, which need the CUDA sparse solver;
- 4 cases of `test_kinetics_base.py`, which need external data (@sec-ch13-kinetics-base);
- the module `test_version_floor.py`.

On the CUDA build, serial `ctest` passes 48 of 49 entries. `pytest` gives 584 passed, 6 skipped and 0
failed.[^ch13-results-cuda] The 6 skips are the 4 external-data cases of `test_kinetics_base.py` and the two version
modules. The C++ programs pass with 105 CUDA instances and 105 CPU instances passing and none failing; the device
dispatch behind those instances is described in @sec-ch12.

The one failing `ctest` entry on both builds is `test_version_floor.py`, and its cause is the environment. The
module calls `pytest.importorskip("setuptools_scm")` at import, before any test is defined
({{< code tests/test_version_floor.py >}}). Without that package, `pytest` collects no test, reports `1 skipped`, and
exits with code 5, "no tests collected". `ctest` counts any non-zero exit as a failure. The sibling
`test_version_fallback.py` makes the same check inside its test function
`test_archive_version_is_not_older_than_the_newest_release`
({{< code tests/test_version_fallback.py test_archive_version_is_not_older_than_the_newest_release >}}). The test is
collected and skipped, `pytest` exits 0, and that entry passes.[^ch13-results-exit5] With `setuptools_scm` present,
the version tests run. On a file system that refuses symbolic links they then fail for another environmental reason:
`tar -x` cannot recreate the repository's symbolic links in the test's archive.[^ch13-results-tar]

### Limits

- The counts are for one host type (compute capability 6.1 GPUs, CUDA 12.6) and one set of library versions. Other
  hosts have not been measured here.
- The version tests have not been run on a file system that allows symbolic links, with `setuptools_scm` present.
  Their real result is missing evidence.
- TODO: run times per entry; not measured.
